description: Returns EU anti-dumping, countervailing, safeguard and steel regulations published in the Official Journal (EUR-Lex), with products, origin countries and the CN/TARIC codes they name. Use it to find trade defence actions on a product or country; use trade_list_quotas for tariff quota volumes, and TARIC for binding duty rates and quota balances. Inputs (all optional, they narrow together): cn (CN/TARIC code, 4 to 10 digits, e.g. 7208; matches broader and narrower codes on the first 8 digits), since (YYYY-MM-DD), instrument, action, country (origin name part, e.g. China), limit (1 to 50, default 20) and cursor (next_cursor, same filters). Output: measures[] with celex, title, action, instrument, products, origin countries, CN/TARIC codes, EUR-Lex URL and observed_at, plus next_cursor and feed freshness; EUR-Lex is checked twice a day. Extracted codes are not a binding duty rate. For one act use HTTP GET /v1/eu/trade-defence/measures/{celex} (see /openapi.json). Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors and empty answers are free. An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

action.description: One kind of action only Allowed: provisional, definitive, amendment, extension, repeal, termination, registration, initiation, quota, other; e.g. provisional.

cn.description: CN/TARIC code, 4 to 10 digits after removing spaces and dots, e.g. 7208 or 72085120

country.description: Origin name substring, 3 to 60 Unicode letters or spaces/punctuation (period, apostrophe, parentheses, hyphen), e.g. China; omit for all origins

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this tool's prior answer; t followed by 1 to 12 digits, e.g. t0. Keep filters unchanged; omit on first call.

instrument.description: One instrument only (steel: acts under the EU steel regime, Regulation 2026/1384) Allowed: anti-dumping, countervailing, safeguard, steel; e.g. anti-dumping.

since.description: Regulations dated on or after, YYYY-MM-DD; e.g. 2026-10-01. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

name: trade_list_measures
title: List EU trade defence measures
